texts: An extended hospital stay is incorrect: early surgical ligation of a PDA in premature babies shortens it: C.
Closing a large duct early stops the flooding of the immature lungs, so ventilation and oxygen are needed for less time.
Less oxygen means less retinopathy of prematurity (retrolental fibroplasia), and better gut blood flow means less necrotizing enterocolitis.
In the picture, the baby with the early ribbon goes home with a short calendar: the bellows stops, the ox takes off its oxygen mask, no cobwebs grow behind the glasses and the spaghetti stays pink.
Memory hook: tie it early, go home early.
